research_notes: Systematic follow-up2026-10-01; repaired absent required research_notes while preserving existing sources, spells and open_questions. Added project assignments separately from proven employment, so government client names never automatically generate public-service years. All substantive hours remain unknown.

Contemporaneous2004 forum source resolves the department name at that observation. KPMG acquisition evidence establishes organisational context without inventing a personal transfer or end date. Smart Energy newsletter corroborates advisory entry by October2022. Climate fund work fills an omitted lead into2024, without asserting a continuous full-time spell.

Publicly indexed professional profile adds dated volunteer and project evidence; direct profile retrieval returned999 and paid employment detail was not publicly exposed. Project dates can differ from employment dates; IGCC discrepancy retained. Additional volunteer, awards and early training entries remain leads for corroboration rather than evidence of full-time work.

Exhausted this pass: targeted CEFC/Banarra secondment and annual-report queries, historical departmental identity, employer acquisition, public profile, primary newsletters, climate-fund committee/report pages. CEFC personal contract/hours unresolved. OnImpact profile returned402 Payment Required; no paid access attempted. Original full-bio failed retrieval. FY2024 fund link now points to updated content, not treated as historical evidence.

Follow-up priorities: early paid career/employers; exact1996–1999 and2003–2004 public-service dates/hours/leave; CEFC payroll and secondment; IGCC role/project distinction; Banarra hours/ownership; Good Car legal appointment/term conflict; climate-fund remuneration and boundaries; project contracting entities. No headline duration inferred from seniority, project budgets or general tenure. Last follow-up2026-10-01; advance nationally before repeating these avenues.

Second follow-up2026-10-02: targeted CEFC site and external-affairs/secondment searches, SEDA and historical annual reports, Banarra2012 association and personal full-time/maternity searches. Retrieved ACF2006–07 report corroborates existing council role; no new personal hours, leave or employment endpoints. Full-time recruitment references concern her parliamentary assistant, not Boele. Derivative January1 CEFC dates not adopted. No material enrichment counted.

Next revisit requires CEFC founding-team/contract records, original SEDA staff documentation or public contract/dated professional-profile evidence. Broad generic biographies and repeated exact-name secondment searches have yielded no additional evidence; retained all open gaps.

Follow-up 2026-10-04: targeted CEFC, SEDA and Good Car Company searches returned the same parliamentary biography and later event profiles already captured. The 2025 RIAA biography still conflicts with the frozen 2024 Good Car endpoint and supplies no appointment or resignation record; CEFC results do not identify secondment/payroll or hours. No new fact promoted. Defer further generic searches until an original board filing, founding-team record or personnel document appears.

Follow-up2026-10-04: Public profile index supplies nine omitted dated volunteer roles; original RIAA2018 and2020 biographies corroborate three and add PRI reference-group participation. Added separate excluded spells without assuming paid employment or government payroll. Intern-host assignments clarified, hours/payment unresolved. AICD ordinary membership and1999 leadership program are not employment evidence. No CEFC secondment or Good Car original filing found. Target original organisation rosters and historical trainee records; do not repeat generic biographies.

2026-10-05 own updated biography newly records establishing an unnamed management consultancy; recorded as unallocated component because possible Banarra identity/ownership relation is unproven. Accessible17February2022interview supports RIAA departure/break without exact payroll date. Historical1998government-report acknowledgement supplies name/referee context only; not new employment or hours. SEDA/CEFC specific searches still no individual hours, leave or secondment. Full-bio old URL404; current own page recovered.

Second targeted pass adds three omitted tertiary qualification/study entries from primary parliamentary index and an unallocated hotel-management trainee component from own indexed1990award account. No course or employment endpoints inferred from award/scholarship years; training employer/pay/hours remain unknown. Direct parliamentary403 and LinkedIn999 limitations recorded. Banarra-founder and CEFC-secondment checks supplied no new contracting boundary; current MP staff job ads refer to staff, not Boele hours. Good Car board-versus-director conflict retained. Next target original hotel trainee award/employer or dated qualification records.

Third targeted pass2026-10-06 adds the omitted 30January–21May2022 Bradfield candidacy and the subsequently documented Shadow Representative office through entry to Parliament. These close the activity chronology after RIAA without classifying campaign or shadow-office work as paid employment. First-party fundraising evidence concerns office operations, not personal remuneration or hours; 2025 campaigning is nested in the broader office activity rather than double-counted. Paid work alongside this political activity remains unresolved.
